name: filename-input
title: Filename Input
description: Selects only the base name on focus, warns with a one-tap undo when the extension changes or disappears, and catches illegal characters, Windows reserved names (CON, NUL.txt), trailing dots and spaces, over-long names and duplicates differing only in case.

meta.summary: Selects only the base name when renaming and catches lost extensions and names Windows can't store, so a rename doesn't break a file.
catches: Extensions changed or removed, with undo
Reserved device names such as CON or NUL.txt
Trailing dots and spaces, and names over the byte limit
Names that differ from an existing file only in capitals
limits: Follows Windows naming rules, the strictest common case; other systems allow more
Duplicate checks only cover the existingNames you pass
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" status
Fixes return focus to the input

sources.label: Microsoft Learn: Naming Files, Paths, and Namespaces

rules.note: Informational. Checked the reserved device names (including superscript-digit COM/LPT) and the rule against trailing spaces and periods.
